answer_1.quote: we validate our method on two language detoxification tasks: detoxified language and dialogue generation. ... Moreover, to further show the general applicability of our method to any attribute-controlled text generation tasks, we validate ADLM on a sentiment-controlled text generation task
datasets: Jigsaw Unintended Bias in Toxicity Classification
answer_1.outputs: Generated text continuations and dialogue responses

answer_2.quote: To automatically measure the toxicity of the generated texts, we utilize Perspective API ... To measure diversity, we calculate the mean of distance n-grams ... To examine the quality of the generated texts, perplexity (PPL) is frequently used as an automatic evaluation measure of fluency ... we evaluate responses by the percentages of bad words and offensiveness using classifiers ... we also test the stance of the responses

answer_4.quote: We performed a human evaluation of generated texts ... by recruiting 45 participants on Mechanical Turk. ... We evaluate the toxicity of generated texts and the quality of the generated texts, e.g. grammatical correctness, coherent topic, and overall fluency
answer_4.guideline: Participants scored toxicity (1-5), grammatical correctness (1-5), topic coherency (1-5), and fluency (1-5) with specific standards for each score.
